name: endless
describe: No end clock: it goes on until the game says it is over, and the score only grows.
pick: play until you fall; the score is how far you got
ends: the rules' check (everyone down, a target reached)

hooks.name: check
hooks.when: ten times a second: is it over? Nothing else ends an endless session

notes: There is no clock: check(ctx) is the only end. Return { winners, reason } when everyone is down, a target is reached or nobody is left; never return null for ever.
ctx.time.left is Infinity and the HUD shows no timer; ctx.time.round still counts the seconds played (make it harder with it).
promise: It goes on until everyone falls, the score shows how far we got, and it plays again.
